title: Numerical approximation of fractional diffusion equations on metric graphs
summary: We study fractional diffusion equations on compact metric graphs, where the nonlocal dynamics is governed by fractional powers of the shifted Kirchhoff-Laplacian. Building on recent advances in the analysis of fractional operators on metric graphs, we establish a rigorous mathematical framework and propose a fully discrete scheme based on backward Euler time-stepping and finite element discretization.
